about: Planning manifest of Circle of the Moon enemies (modding/tools/cotm_enemies.py). The game never reads this file. Nothing is built for an entry until "enabled" is true; "compendium" separately gives it a Monster Compendium entry. Battle Arena copies are left out.
source: User's own USA CotM ROM, read-only. Stats and room data are ROM-derived; do not distribute.

fields.group: work-set tag for planning (e.g. "catacombs"); builds nothing by itself
fields.hod_name: EnemyParam row / module name the build would use (DLL_ = loaded as its own module, the DLC way)
fields.hod_stock: the same monster already in HoD, if any (calibration and fallback)
fields.actors.placed: CotM actor type placed in rooms for this enemy (every room it appears in loads only this enemy)
fields.actors.candidates: other actor types that may belong to it (children, projectiles, alternatives); unverified
fields.placements: CotM area / room indexes (randomizer numbering) and how many are placed there
fields.stats.drops: CotM item id and rate, as stored
